mapper.select: SELECT ci.id AS id, ci.user_id as user_id, ci.meal_date as meal_date, ci.meal_type as meal_type, ci.RCP_SEQ as rcp_seq, r.RCP_NM as rcp_nm, r.ATT_FILE_NO_MAIN as att_file_no_main FROM CALENDAR_ITEM ci JOIN RECIPE r ON ci.RCP_SEQ = r.RCP_SEQ WHERE ci.user_id = #{user_id} AND TO_CHAR(ci.meal_date, 'YYYY') = #{year} AND TO_CHAR(ci.meal_date, 'MM') = #{month} ORDER BY ci.meal_date, ci.meal_type
